newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq discusses setting up free trade zone - papers.
newsitem.headline: Iraq discusses setting up free trade zone - papers.

text.p: Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein and his cabinet have discussed setting up a free-trade zone in southern Iraq, newspapers said on Wednesday.
"The cabinet...discussed the establishment of a free trade and industry zone in Basra," the government newspaper al- Jumhouriya said, quoting a cabinet meeting chaired by Saddam.
The paper gave no further details but it said the cabinet ratified the idea and asked the Iraqi Economic Affairs Committee to study its practical implementation.
It said the zone would be set up near the Khour al-Zubair area where stores, communications, terminals and transport facilities were available.
Iraq is under stringent U.N. trade sanctions imposed after its 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
